inputs.request: Execute standard OMP work in place at collector taskDepth 0 with one resumable non-isolated child and explicit caller response-object schema. As an independent capability counterfactual, taskDepth > 0 must stop transport-unavailable before any child allocation without delegated-controller substitution; capable other-host topology and named lifecycle semantics remain unchanged. Retain the exact attempt-1 launch candidate, then separately request rethink and its wake-job Handoff. Review returns one material finding with a fixed closure check. Resume the same child for attempt 2 through write agent://<child>, binding task/attempt/owner/receiver/candidate, operation/report identity, invocation and schema. Keep one outstanding request with all earlier child jobs retained. Read details.message.receipts[].outcome: failed and injected stop without waiting for a new row; changed-identity revived stops; only woken or same-identity revived enters collection. From launch or eligible follow-up receipt keep native wait active in the same controller turn until the original matching result and row are retained. Ordinary wait messages do not finish collection; never end that turn or admit display-only auto-delivery without its retained original structured object. The first subsequent task-job row has job id childId-2, native agentUrlId equal to childId, successful resolution and valid caller-schema data with exactly one string response. Retain original result and row before response_object decoding and admit once. Immediately send separate rethink and collect its eligible wake reply; do not wait out holds. Independently reject an old launch row, duplicate admitted row, foreign agentUrlId, text-only successful resolve and rejected job carrying structured data. Admit a later eligible request's reused plain childId only by its own receipt/order/phase binding, not ID novelty. Verify original checks and closure. Reject resend, replacement, reset, new polling, OMP token/restatement, output/history/relay fallback, duplicate admission, review rerun or controller repair. Independent scripted follow-up after an eligible woken receipt on the same bound child: the request states that the terminal return is one direct native yield tool call, never eval, tool.yield, getattr(tool, 'yield'), a prelude helper or any tool bridge, because a bridged yield reports Result submitted. but registers no launch or wake job. The child's reply turn nevertheless ends with a bridged yield, no task-job row is registered, and the controller's next native wait, issued after reading the receipt, returns text No running background jobs to wait for. with details.jobs []. Stop that request as a missing reply and assess it under the shared execution-recovery policy: no admission, further wait, resend, replacement or reset. A wakeRelay or ordinary message received before that result only continues collection; relay, text, agent output and history are never admitted.
